title: Ukanushaji kwa Kuzingatia Hali (Theme 13: Heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains negation and negates hu- (habit) with ha-...-i and -me- (perfect) with -ja-.
representations: a negation table with hu- and -me-

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Wao hawali nyama" and the negative of "Wamefika".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: Amefika." Kwa nini "Hakufika" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Kanusha: Hufika." Kwa nini "Hahufika" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Hali ya mazoea hukanushwa kwa hafiki.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: Wamefika." Kwa nini "Hawakufika" si jibu sahihi?

listen_for: Yeye si huenda sokoni kila Jumamosi.
misconceptions.repair: Hali ya mazoea hukanushwa kwa ha-...-i: haendi.
